overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.description: +30% Grass damage while below half HP.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.description: +30% Fire damage while below half HP.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.description: +30% Water damage while below half HP.

static.name: Static
static.description: Pokémon that hit it in melee become Paralyzed.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.description: Once per battle, survives a knockout blow with 1 HP.

keen-eye.name: Keen Eye
keen-eye.description: Sees through bushes: they do not block its line of sight.

run-away.name: Run Away
run-away.description: Steps away from engaged foes without free attacks.

poison-point.name: Poison Point
poison-point.description: Pokémon that hit it in melee become Poisoned.

inner-focus.name: Inner Focus
inner-focus.description: Can't be intimidated: immune to Weakened.

effect-spore.name: Effect Spore
effect-spore.description: Pokémon that hit it in melee become Poisoned.

anger-point.name: Anger Point
anger-point.description: +1 Attack each time a move hits it (max +3, this battle).

arena-trap.name: Arena Trap
arena-trap.description: Enemies that start their turn next to it cannot move.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.description: +30% Bug damage while below half HP.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.description: Floats above the ground: Slow never applies.

cute-charm.name: Cute Charm
cute-charm.description: Pokémon that hit it in melee are charmed: Slow for 1 turn.

thick-fat.name: Thick Fat
thick-fat.description: Takes 50% less damage from Fire and Ice moves.

swift-swim.name: Swift Swim
swift-swim.description: +1 movement (up to the movement cap), and its Water moves deal 10% more damage.

shell-armor.name: Shell Armor
shell-armor.description: Never takes critical hits, and takes 10% less damage.

battle-armor.name: Battle Armor
battle-armor.description: Never takes critical hits, and takes 10% less damage.

flame-body.name: Flame Body
flame-body.description: Pokémon that hit it in melee become Burned.

guts.name: Guts
guts.description: +30% damage while it carries a status, and Burn doesn't lower its damage.

flash-fire.name: Flash Fire
flash-fire.description: Takes 50% less damage from Fire moves, and its Fire moves deal 25% more.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer (not Paralysis, Freeze or Sleep; at most +2 in all).

oblivious.name: Oblivious
oblivious.description: Can't be charmed or taunted: Slow and Taunted never apply.

clear-body.name: Clear Body
clear-body.description: Its Attack can't be lowered: immune to Weakened.

hyper-cutter.name: Hyper Cutter
hyper-cutter.description: Its Attack can't be lowered: immune to Weakened.

insomnia.name: Insomnia
insomnia.description: Can't be put to sleep: immune to Sleep.

water-absorb.name: Water Absorb
water-absorb.description: Takes 50% less damage from Water moves, and heals 5% of max HP at the start of each of its turns.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.description: +15% damage against targets out of melee reach.

compound-eyes.name: Compound Eyes
compound-eyes.description: +1 max range on moves that reach 2 or more (up to 4; Bond moves no limit), and its shots pass over Pokémon in the way.

shed-skin.name: Shed Skin
shed-skin.description: Shakes off foes' statuses at the start of its turn, after status damage.

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.description: +1 Attack each time it knocks out a foe (max +3, this battle).
